blind.description: A medieval/fantasy stone watchtower or turret. It consists of a conical roof covered in tiered, scalloped dark slate-grey shingles, topped with a smooth white spherical finial. The main cylindrical body is made of light grey/beige ashlar stone masonry with mortar lines and subtle weathering, featuring a single arched recessed stone window on one side. Below the cylinder is a projecting stone cornice resting on an inverted, stepped corbel base that tapers to a small cylindrical foot resting flat on the ground. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating flakes. Nothing is hovering, melted, or fused. It stands on its own base with no added plinth, slab, or disc. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a concentric circular rosette or dartboard pattern formed entirely by the conical roof. A small white sphere sits at the center, surrounded by concentric rings of overlapping rounded scalloped roof shingles in dark grey, with the eaves completely concealing the tower body and base below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 8 to 9 ft tall (approximately 1.4 to 1.5 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 ft wide across the roof diameter (roughly two-thirds the height of the figure).
